title: Key at a list index
statement: Let $\pi$ be a list of natural numbers, let $kd:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, and let $j<|\pi|$. The value of $kd$ at the entry of $\pi$ indexed by $j$ is $kd(\pi_j)$.
hypotheses_covered: The index $j$ is less than the length of $\pi$
